meta.notes: The tutorial's first mission: one man and his rifle on a snowed-in mountain road at night, walked along one line (the stopped truck, the road post's wall and gateway, the hut, the sandbags under a machine gun, the roadblock's wall, the upper gate). Its fights are staged by levels/tut-road.script.ts. The snow is in the file. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts tut-road

steps.line: Use [W] [A] [S] [D] to move, and get behind the truck
Hold [Ctrl] and move the mouse to turn the view and look up the road
Press [2] to bring up your rifle
Hold [Shift] to sprint to the wall by the gate
Walk into the wall to snap to it for cover

explain.title: Taking cover on a wall
explain.text: Walk into a wall and you'll snap to it, with your back against it and out of the line of fire. Use the move keys to slide along it. When you reach its end, aim past the corner and you'll lean out to shoot.

steps.line: Slide along to the gate, then aim past the corner to lean out
Left-click to shoot the sentry
Press [Z] to switch to full auto
steps.setupLine: Press [2] again and then [1] to switch to full auto

explain.title: Setting up your gun
explain.text: When you're holding a gun, press its key again to open its setup menu above the kit strip. You can switch between single shots and full auto there.

steps.line: Move away from the wall to step off it
Go through the gate to the hut's wooden door
Hold the left mouse button to shoot the wooden door until it breaks
Press [R] to reload
Shoot the enemy through the wooden wall

explain.title: Shooting through thin walls
explain.text: A rifle round will go through wood, plaster and doors. An enemy behind them isn't safe from you, and you aren't safe from him. Concrete, brick and sandbags will stop it.

steps.line: Go out the side door and stop behind the wall
Press [C] to crouch, and the shots will go over you
Stay low and follow the sandbags
Walk into the concrete wall to take cover
Slide to the corner, lean out and shoot the gunner
Watch the upper gate for more enemies
Hold the left mouse button and shoot them all
Go to the green trunk behind the machine gun
Press [Space] to take the radio
Go out through the upper gate
